description: The agent must: (1) Read the lead batch and routing config from the workspace. (2) Produce `pipeline_plan.json` containing all 5 required output sections from the skill's Output Contract: `lead_intake_validation`, `qualification_logic`, `routing_and_ownership_plan`, `followup_cadence`, and `pipeline_risk_alerts`. (3) In Lead Intake Validation: identify leads L-20260303-02 (missing qualification_goal), L-20260303-03 (missing email), and L-20260303-09 (missing name/company/job_title) as having critical missing fields and flag them for the enrichment queue — NOT direct routing. (4) In Qualification Logic: apply the exact proprietary formula `score = intent_score + fit_score + urgency_score` with the threshold `>= 80` for high_priority routing — no lead in this batch scores ≥80 so none should be labeled high_priority via the formula alone. (5) In Routing and Ownership Plan: generate routing payloads using the exact fields `lead_id`, `route_to`, and `sla_hours` as specified in the skill's Routing Payload format. (6) Apply the channel-aware differentiation rule: Meta and TikTok leads require creative testing cadence recommendations; Google Ads leads require demand-capture and search-intent focus — these must NOT be collapsed into a single generic recommendation. (7) In Follow-up Cadence: enforce the same-day (4-hour SLA) response rule for any leads identified as high-intent. (8) In Pipeline Risk Alerts: include at least one explicit rollback or stop-loss condition tied to spend risk (e.g., pause TikTok budget if low-fit leads dominate). (9) Separate observed facts from assumptions using measurable language throughout.
